thesis: Light held as form: study the continuous arc, let its existing warmth become perceptually present, then give the object space to remain. Governed semantics are inherited by beat reference; treatment never supplies replacement editorial facts.

productPriority.principle: The continuous graphite arc, diffuser and grounded base read as one object; warm illumination is subordinate to geometry, and editable type occupies existing negative space.
productPriority.heroHoldPolicy: Recognition precedes embellishment. Whole-object beats settle early; the breathing-room beat is still throughout, and the close retains its complete composition through the last frame. Relative treatment deadlines are specified in the handoff without moving governed boundaries.
productPriority.atmosphereLimit: Use the photographed atmosphere only. No added particles, fog, beams, floating dust, bloom pulses or moving background planes. Preserve stone contact, edge separation and diffuser texture.

visualHierarchy: Continuous arc and grounded base, or the existing material junction in the detail study
Photographed diffuser warmth and its existing spatial response
Governed editable typography in quiet negative space
Stone surface, reflections and charcoal environment as one intact plate

sceneFamilies.purpose: Establish the whole object, then return to it as an unhurried visual rest.
allowedTechniques: Small uniform scale settlement before a locked hold
avoid: Loss of arc tip, base or contact shadow

sceneFamilies.purpose: Let curvature and the shell/diffuser junction carry attention without a technical demonstration.
allowedTechniques: Very small uniform whole-plate scale change followed by stillness

sceneFamilies.purpose: Pair a settled product image with the complete governed statement, preserving product primacy.
allowedTechniques: Separate plain typography field if needed for source safety

sceneFamilies.purpose: Make the existing warm illumination arrive as a controlled perceptual event, then hold it.
allowedTechniques: Monotonic uniform reveal of the already-lit whole plate

beatTreatments.visualPriority: Recognizable arc, base and contact as a single sculpture; open space above is intentional.
beatTreatments.cameraIntent: Reveal the intact plate with at most a small uniform approach, then stop early for recognition.
beatTreatments.typographyIntent: Inherit the governed absence of copy; leave the space empty.
beatTreatments.transitionIntent: Opening reveal belongs wholly to this beat. Exit on a hard cut to the detail study without overlapping source assignments.
beatTreatments.audioIntent: Give the governed low accent a rounded, soft onset; a sparse low bed opens without a trailer impact.

sourceTreatment.strategy: Whole source with original contact shadow and reflection retained; no local relighting.

beatTreatments.fallback: Use the intact source at native framing, reveal uniformly, and hold without camera motion.
riskNotes: Existing diffuser warmth must not be erased to manufacture an off state.
Darkening must not make the opening silhouette unreadable.

beatTreatments.visualPriority: Existing graphite texture and continuous frosted junction; the source's authored crop is the study.
beatTreatments.cameraIntent: Allow only a very small uniform scale settlement; stop before the final portion of the beat.
beatTreatments.typographyIntent: No additional copy, diagrams or material specifications.
beatTreatments.transitionIntent: Hard cuts at entry and exit articulate a change in photographic scale; no faux matched geometry.
beatTreatments.audioIntent: Continue the sparse bed without inventing a discrete cue at this boundary; expose a little higher tonal texture without literal machinery sound.

sourceTreatment.strategy: Keep the supplied close crop intact; do not reconstruct the cropped tip, base or unseen material.

beatTreatments.fallback: Hold the authored detail image completely still.
riskNotes: Additional magnification can lose material definition.
The image cannot support independent diffuser motion or a new camera angle.

beatTreatments.visualPriority: Whole profile and grounded base first; the governed statement reads clearly in upper negative space.
beatTreatments.cameraIntent: Lock the supplied composition; preserve the visible left-edge band as source content.
beatTreatments.typographyIntent: Reveal the complete governed word together in an off-white medium-weight sans; hold without movement or tracking animation.
beatTreatments.transitionIntent: Hard cut into the profile; hard cut at exit into the incoming activation treatment, with no inter-source dissolve.
beatTreatments.audioIntent: Use the governed low accent as editorial punctuation, shorter and quieter in perceived weight than the opening; no letter-synced hits.

sourceTreatment.strategy: Intact plate with text placed above the arc, outside the left-edge band; no patching or background extension.

beatTreatments.fallback: Contain the whole source below a separate plain upper typography field, keeping product and contact fully visible; accept the existing edge band.
riskNotes: Left-edge band and lower surface discontinuity are baked into the source.
Do not attempt a true side-view reconstruction from the supplied profile composition.

beatTreatments.visualPriority: Existing amber diffuser and photographed nearby warmth become present while the graphite outline remains legible.
beatTreatments.cameraIntent: Fixed whole-source framing throughout; the reveal supplies the only visual rise and resolves into stillness.
beatTreatments.typographyIntent: Keep activation free of typography and explanatory claims.
beatTreatments.transitionIntent: Start the incoming whole plate attenuated but readable, then reveal monotonically to its native appearance; exit by hard cut to the quieter assigned composition.
beatTreatments.audioIntent: The governed activation cue begins at this beat's boundary, slowly opens in warmth and width with the reveal, then settles without an impact or overshoot.

sourceTreatment.strategy: Uniform reveal of the already-lit source including its baked spill and reflection; this is editorial exposure, not independent emitter or room-light simulation.

beatTreatments.fallback: Use a shallower uniform reveal if shadow detail suffers; if any attenuation is unsafe, hold the original lit plate and let the governed audio rise provide activation emphasis.
riskNotes: No unlit state or separately addressable emission layer exists in this source.
Do not brighten beyond the original source or erase diffuser texture.
Returning to a quieter plate is an editorial cut, not a demonstrated power-off event.

beatTreatments.visualPriority: Whole-object recognition and negative space; stillness is the purposeful aftermath of activation.
beatTreatments.cameraIntent: Native framing, fully settled from the first frame through the last; no zoom, pulse or secondary reveal.
beatTreatments.typographyIntent: Keep the governed empty space free of copy.
beatTreatments.transitionIntent: Hard cut in and out; accept the assigned quieter source without matching it through invented illumination.
beatTreatments.audioIntent: Let the previous resonance recede into a near-silent continuous bed; add no cue or anticipation ramp here.

sourceTreatment.strategy: Intact source held still, including its original residual warmth, surface and reflection.

beatTreatments.fallback: The unchanged whole-source still is already the primary and fallback treatment.
riskNotes: A fresh effects peak would reverse the governed breathing-room purpose.
Do not recolor this source to imitate the activation plate.

beatTreatments.visualPriority: Settled illuminated form with one complete editable statement; no second activation.
beatTreatments.cameraIntent: Lock the intact lit composition from entry, retaining the original source appearance.
beatTreatments.typographyIntent: Use the same word hierarchy and complete-text reveal as the earlier editorial beat; hold comfortably in upper negative space.
beatTreatments.transitionIntent: Hard cuts preserve a clear editorial return to the lit state; no flash or luminance pumping.
beatTreatments.audioIntent: A soft governed low accent restores presence over a restrained warm bed; do not repeat the activation rise.

sourceTreatment.strategy: Whole lit plate without added glow, independent emission or shadow manipulation.

beatTreatments.fallback: Keep the image still and use the separate upper typography field if negative-space readability is insufficient.
riskNotes: Repeating the activation animation weakens the distinction between event and settled character.
Oversaturated amber would flatten graphite and diffuser detail.

beatTreatments.visualPriority: Complete product silhouette and governed closing line, both available early and retained through the last frame.
beatTreatments.cameraIntent: Fixed whole-source framing from entry; no exit movement or fade to black.
beatTreatments.typographyIntent: Reveal the complete governed line together above the arc, using a compact single line if readable or an intentional two-line break; no added wordmark or CTA.
beatTreatments.transitionIntent: Hard cut into the final composition, with only a short text-opacity reveal; retain the final image without an outgoing transition.
beatTreatments.audioIntent: Use the governed low accent as a soft final point, then resolve the bed toward silence without a final sting or tail beyond the governed end.

sourceTreatment.strategy: Keep the whole end-card source and its baked upper tonal band; place editable text with comfortable separation from the arc.

beatTreatments.fallback: Contain the intact source beneath a plain upper typography field, holding product and complete line at readable sizes through the final frame.
riskNotes: Asset-generation notes mention branding, but the governed storyboard supplies only the closing line; do not introduce extra copy.
The upper tonal band must not be patched or mistaken for a separate movable layer.

typographyDirection.hierarchy: Use a restrained modern sans-serif, medium weight, warm off-white, modest fixed tracking. Product remains dominant; support statements share one scale, and the longer closing statement may reduce scale or wrap without changing wording.
typographyDirection.motionPrinciple: Complete phrases arrive by short opacity reveals with fixed position and tracking; no stagger, bounce, blur, word replacement or exit animation.
typographyDirection.readabilityRule: Typeset only the governed copy at runtime. Keep text within the upper negative-space zone with a clear product gap; use a separate plain field with the entire source contained if contrast or collision fails. Resolve all reveals early and preserve full-copy holds.

audioDirection.structure: Sparse low foundation, exposed material texture, editorial punctuation, one controlled warm opening, a near-silent spatial rest, then settled warmth and a restrained resolution. No voiceover or driving percussion grid.
audioDirection.cuePolicy: Inherit every cue and its boundary from the storyboard. Governed low accents are rounded punctuation with different contextual weight; the activation cue is a sustained rise rather than a transient hit. Do not invent cues on uncued beats or add an impact cue.
audioDirection.dynamicIntent: The activation has the broadest tonal opening, not the hardest transient. The breathing-room beat has the lowest sustained density. Preserve quiet contrast at phone playback levels and mono compatibility; resolve audio within the governed endpoint.

masteringIntent.color: SDR BT.709; preserve neutral graphite, warm amber, shadow separation and textured highlights without HDR-style bloom or crushed blacks.
masteringIntent.deliveryNotes: Inherit delivery dimensions, frame rate and duration from governed inputs. Later implementation must verify actual color conversion and signaling, decode integrity, quiet-detail retention and full-speed human playback; design validation is not media acceptance.

riskFallbacks.risk: Flattened imagery cannot safely support extraction, emitter-only animation or independent spatial layers.
riskFallbacks.fallback: Use the intact assigned source with uniform treatment only; isolation and cleanup are disabled in this design and are never prerequisites.

riskFallbacks.risk: Typography competes with the product or existing source bands.
riskFallbacks.fallback: Use a fixed plain upper text field and contain the entire assigned source below it without stretching, masking or filling missing background.

riskFallbacks.risk: Activation attenuation obscures the object or creates visible tonal steps.
riskFallbacks.fallback: Reduce attenuation; if unsafe at any strength, hold native source appearance and retain the audio rise without inventing optical behavior.

riskFallbacks.risk: Subtle motion damages crop safety or suggests false parallax.
riskFallbacks.fallback: Remove camera motion and retain intentional hard cuts and stable holds.

riskFallbacks.risk: Source discontinuities remain visible at delivery size.
riskFallbacks.fallback: Preserve and disclose them; if unacceptable in independent review, hold for governance instead of repairing canonical imagery.
